faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about tickets, check-ins, and prescriptions.
faq.q1: Do I need an account before browsing doctors and open time slots?
faq.a1: No. You can search specialists, check transparent visit prices, and pick your date and time freely. Sign-in is only required when confirming your ticket, and you return straight to your reserved slot.
faq.q2: How does reception check-in work with my Ticket Code?
faq.a2: After confirmation you receive a CLR ticket code, queue token (#A-01), and scannable QR code. Reception marks your arrival and updates your status live.
faq.q3: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment if plans change?
faq.a3: Yes. Open any Confirmed ticket in My Clinic Tickets to reschedule to a new open slot or cancel immediately—freeing that slot for other patients.
faq.q4: When do my digital prescriptions appear?
faq.a4: As soon as your physician completes the consultation, your diagnosis and medication table appear automatically inside My Prescriptions with A4 print support.
